item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hovers around 1.1650 as RSI signals fading momentum
item.description: EUR/USD moves little after registering modest losses in the previous session, trading around 1.1650 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) momentum indicator, currently at 40 (below the 50 midline), signals weak momentum without indicating oversold conditions.

item.title: USD/CHF posts mild gains above 0.8000 as US CPI inflation data in line
item.description: The USD/CHF pair posts modest gains around 0.8010 during the early European session on Wednesday. The Greenback strengthens against the Swiss Franc (CHF) after US inflation data that was broadly in line with estimates.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD edges lower to near 1.3425 early Asian session
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.3425 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday, pressured by renewed US Dollar (USD) demand. Traders brace for the US Retail Sales and Producer Price Index (PPI) data later on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/INR falls on positive outcome from US-India trade talks
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades higher against the US Dollar in the opening session on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair drops to near 90.30 as the Indian Rupee gains on the outcome of trade talks between the United States (US) and India on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold hits fresh record highs above $4,600 due to safe-haven demand
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) reaches the fresh record high of $4,639.77 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Precious metals, including Gold, attract buyers amid growing bets on Federal Reserve (Fed) rate cuts following the softer inflation in the United States (US).

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Approaches 160.00 on Yen’s continued underperformance
item.description: The USD/JPY pair posts a fresh one-and-a-half-year high near 159.45 during the early European trading session on Wednesday. The pair strengthens as the Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to underperform across the board amid political uncertainty in Japan.
